_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 96 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: Fragmentation Grenade

description.text: Equipped with an impact-triggered time fuse, this grenade is ideal for targeting enemies behind cover. Deadly when close to blast radius.

_unlock_note: Reported unlocked by default on 2026-08-02. Not yet confirmed against an in-game capture: unlock text only displays on items the account does not own, and all throwables are owned.
